en: The image shows a monochrome photograph of a street in ruins, with several people and a horse-drawn carriage visible in the foreground. The buildings appear heavily damaged, likely due to a fire, as suggested by the text. A minaret is visible in the background, indicating the presence of an Ottoman-era mosque. The general setting and clothing of the figures point to an early 20th-century scene. The postcard contains printed text at the bottom.
